versos.grego: Συνεργοῦντες δὲ καὶ παρακαλοῦμεν μὴ εἰς κενὸν τὴν χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ δέξασθαι ὑμᾶς·

controles.web: Working together, we entreat also that you not receive the grace of God in vain,
controles.kjv: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
controles.livre: E nós, como trabalhadores conjuntamente com ele , rogamos que não tenhais recebido a graça de Deus em vão.

versos.grego: —λέγει γάρ Καιρῷ δεκτῷ ἐπήκουσά σου καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ σωτηρίας ἐβοήθησά σοι· ἰδοὺ νῦν καιρὸς εὐπρόσδεκτος, ἰδοὺ νῦν ἡμέρα σωτηρίας·—

controles.web: for he says,  “At an acceptable time I listened to you, in a day of salvation I helped you.”    Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.
controles.kjv: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
controles.livre: Porque ele diz: Em tempo agradável te ouvi, e no dia da salvação te socorri; eis agora o tempo agradável, eis agora o dia da salvação

versos.grego: μηδεμίαν ἐν μηδενὶ διδόντες προσκοπήν, ἵνα μὴ μωμηθῇ ἡ διακονία,

controles.web: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,
controles.kjv: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
controles.livre: Escândalo nenhum damos em coisa alguma, para que nosso trabalho não seja acusado.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ἐν παντὶ συνιστάνοντες ἑαυτοὺς ὡς Θεοῦ διάκονοι, ἐν ὑπομονῇ πολλῇ, ἐν θλίψεσιν, ἐν ἀνάγκαις, ἐν στενοχωρίαις,

controles.web: but in everything commending ourselves, as servants of God, in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,
controles.kjv: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
controles.livre: Mas em tudo nos fizemos agradáveis como trabalhadores de Deus, em muita tolerância, em aflições, em necessidades, em angústias;

versos.grego: ἐν πληγαῖς, ἐν φυλακαῖς, ἐν ἀκαταστασίαις, ἐν κόποις, ἐν ἀγρυπνίαις, ἐν νηστείαις,

controles.web: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;
controles.kjv: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
controles.livre: Em açoites, em prisões, em tumultos, em trabalhos, em vigílias, em jejuns;

versos.grego: ἐν ἁγνότητι, ἐν γνώσει, ἐν μακροθυμίᾳ, ἐν χρηστότητι, ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ, ἐν ἀγάπῃ ἀνυποκρίτῳ,

controles.web: in pureness, in knowledge, in patience, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,
controles.kjv: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
controles.livre: Em pureza, em conhecimento, em paciência, em bondade, no Espírito Santo, em amor não fingido;

versos.grego: ἐν λόγῳ ἀληθείας, ἐν δυνάμει Θεοῦ· διὰ τῶν ὅπλων τῆς δικαιοσύνης τῶν δεξιῶν καὶ ἀριστερῶν,

controles.web: in the word of truth, in the power of God; by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
controles.kjv: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
controles.livre: Em palavra da verdade, em poder de Deus, com armas da justiça, à esquerda, e à direita;

versos.grego: διὰ δόξης καὶ ἀτιμίας, διὰ δυσφημίας καὶ εὐφημίας· ὡς πλάνοι καὶ ἀληθεῖς,

controles.web: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and yet true;
controles.kjv: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
controles.livre: Por honra e por desonra; por infâmia e por boa fama; considerados como enganadores, e como verdadeiros.

versos.grego: ὡς ἀγνοούμενοι καὶ ἐπιγινωσκόμενοι, ὡς ἀποθνήσκοντες καὶ ἰδοὺ ζῶμεν, ὡς παιδευόμενοι καὶ μὴ θανατούμενοι,

controles.web: as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as punished, and not killed;
controles.kjv: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
controles.livre: Como estranhos, e conhecidos; como morrendo, e eis que estamos vivendo; como castigados e ainda não mortos.

versos.grego: ὡς λυπούμενοι ἀεὶ δὲ χαίροντες, ὡς πτωχοὶ πολλοὺς δὲ πλουτίζοντες, ὡς μηδὲν ἔχοντες καὶ πάντα κατέχοντες.

controles.web: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
controles.kjv: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
controles.livre: Como entristecidos, porém sempre alegres; como pobres, porém enriquecendo a muitos; como nada tendo, e possuindo tudo.

versos.grego: Τὸ στόμα ἡμῶν ἀνέῳγεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, Κορίνθιοι, ἡ καρδία ἡμῶν πεπλάτυνται·

controles.web: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
controles.kjv: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
controles.livre: Para vós, ó coríntios, está aberta nossa boca; e nosso coração está ampliado.

versos.grego: οὐ στενοχωρεῖσθε ἐν ἡμῖν, στενοχωρεῖσθε δὲ ἐν τοῖς σπλάγχνοις ὑμῶν·

controles.web: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
controles.kjv: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
controles.livre: Nós não temos lhes estreitado, mas vós estais estreitos em nossos sentimentos.

versos.grego: τὴν δὲ αὐτὴν ἀντιμισθίαν, ὡς τέκνοις λέγω, πλατύνθητε καὶ ὑμεῖς.

controles.web: Now in return, I speak as to my children, you also be open wide.
controles.kjv: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
controles.livre: E em recompensa disto (falo como a filhos) alargai vós também.

versos.grego: Μὴ γίνεσθε ἑτεροζυγοῦντες ἀπίστοις· τίς γὰρ μετοχὴ δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἀνομίᾳ, ἢ τίς κοινωνία φωτὶ πρὸς σκότος;

controles.web: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship have righteousness and iniquity? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?
controles.kjv: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
controles.livre: Não vos ajunteis em outro jugo com os descrentes. Porque, que parceria tem a justiça com injustiça? E que parceria tem a luz com as trevas?

versos.grego: τίς δὲ συμφώνησις Χριστοῦ πρὸς Βελιάρ, ἢ τίς μερὶς πιστῷ μετὰ ἀπίστου;

controles.web: What agreement has Christ with Belial? Or what portion has a believer with an unbeliever?
controles.kjv: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
controles.livre: E que acordo há entre Cristo e Belial? Ou que parte tem o crente com o incrédulo?

versos.grego: τίς δὲ συνκατάθεσις ναῷ Θεοῦ μετὰ εἰδώλων; ἡμεῖς γὰρ ναὸς Θεοῦ ἐσμεν ζῶντος· καθὼς εἶπεν ὁ Θεὸς ὅτι Ἐνοικήσω ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐνπεριπατήσω, καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτῶν Θεός, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔσονταί μου λαός.

controles.web: What agreement has a temple of God with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
controles.kjv: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
controles.livre: E que acordo há entre o Templo de Deus e os ídolos? Porque vós sois o templo do Deus vivente, como Deus disse: Neles habitarei, e entre eles andarei; e eu serei seu Deus, e eles serão meu povo.

versos.grego: διὸ ἐξέλθατε ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν, καὶ ἀφορίσθητε, λέγει Κύριος, καὶ ἀκαθάρτου μὴ ἅπτεσθε· κἀγὼ εἰσδέξομαι ὑμᾶς,

controles.web: Therefore  “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
controles.kjv: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,
controles.livre: Portanto: saí do meio deles, e vos separai, diz o Senhor; e não toqueis coisa impura, e eu vos aceitarei.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔσομαι ὑμῖν εἰς Πατέρα, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔσεσθέ μοι εἰς υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας, λέγει Κύριος Παντοκράτωρ.

controles.web: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’    says the Lord Almighty.”
controles.kjv: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
controles.livre: E eu vos serei por Pai, e vós sereis para mim filhos e filhas,diz o Senhor Todo Poderoso.
